about: Reviewed facts about each Go module linked into rio's release binaries, applied by tools/source-sbom.sh. creator is the module's project page (BSI TR-03183-2 5.2.2 accepts the project's web page); licence is the concluded SPDX expression, read from the module's licence files. detected records what cyclonedx-gomod's licence detection reports where the conclusion differs, and note says why. A module with no row, or a detection that differs from both, fails the script.

github.com/rebaze/rio.note: rio itself; its creator comes from enrichment.subject.manufacturer

github.com/opencontainers/go-digest.creator: https://github.com/opencontainers/go-digest
github.com/opencontainers/go-digest.note: CC-BY-SA-4.0 is LICENSE.docs, the documentation's licence; the code's LICENSE is Apache-2.0

gopkg.in/yaml.v3.creator: https://github.com/go-yaml/yaml
gopkg.in/yaml.v3.note: LICENSE covers the files ported from libyaml under MIT and the rest under Apache-2.0
